Thang, Marie-Felicia and Enrico have presented their most recent works at the 2026 European Causal Inference Meeting, organized at Oxford University, UK this April.

[![](/files/images/eurocim26.jpeg)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.04450)

Thang's work introduces a novel method based on optimal transport to generalize results of a source trial to a new target population that has limited aggregate information on the case-mix. Marie-Felicia proposes a new framework for causally interpretable meta-mediation analysis with time-to-event outcomes. Enrico discusses design-aware constraint-based causal discovery for complex survey data.
